title: Observation recorder recovery
details: If the phone camera or microphone stops unexpectedly during a video observation, Milos no longer leaves the assessment screen frozen
The recorded clip is retained so Competent or More required and the Finish controls remain usable
If the recorder stops on the final AC after a judgement has already been selected, Milos finishes and saves that clip automatically
The stopped recording time is held on screen instead of continuing to count after the camera has stopped
Review, calendar, evidence, QR, mileage and course behaviour are otherwise unchanged
